english.note: Use this for a person who passes information between an organization and other groups or the public.

examples.english: If you have any questions, you can contact me as the liaison and I’ll pass them on to the organizers.
examples.traditional: 有咩問題可以搵我做聯絡人，我會轉告主辦方。
